as_traded.notes: EXISTS; input profile must prove later split ratios present in this bounded source explain its adjustment vintage. A 2026-adjusted close cannot be repaired by silently dropping2026 splits. Reject unresolved basis before this transform. Irregular and unsupported holding-period actions are excluded downstream; unknown action histories remain labeled assumptions. Pin irregular_tolerance to the existing feature workflow.

option_chain.notes: PROPOSED. Protected intake selects metadata-proven pre2026 members/partitions BEFORE parsing/dedup; filtering ObservationStreamRows output is NOT sufficient. Missing trusted member bounds or mixed JSON members refuse rather than scan2026. Preserve dedup/fingerprints across per-source roots. Only then apply exact DTE and named phase windows and field mapping. G1 verifies registrations/fields/standard deliverables and safe metadata census; quote and expiry both before2026. No provider acquisition.

model_inputs.notes: Existing ParquetRows, not a new feature builder. G2 replaces the placeholder projection from the verified archived42-feature/scale contract and pins the source snapshot/hash to the inference package. No guesses or all-column imputation. Both date bounds apply before materialization; forward labels are not passed as model features. Missing or incompatible profile refuses. This source already exists; no acquisition of new market data.

forecasts.notes: PROPOSED inference wrapper. Use verified42-feature rows, exact order, scale and ticker encoding, archived training medians for admitted missing values, then loaded scaler/mask exactly once. G2 pins snapshots/schema/preprocessing and parity against saved forecasts. Schedule cutoff includes monitoring and other fitted selection labels, plus availability; require origin within archived forecast-valid interval. No compatible checkpoint/feature/head/profile -> explicit skip. Seed and estimator must match loaded state. As-traded spot has G1 verified strike basis. Own-date forecast uses own-date data and retains look-ahead fill label.

masses.notes: PROPOSED mean-preserving strike projection; grid all chain strikes before liquidity, tails at extremes. Report Delta in spot units, CDF deviations and nominal payoff-integral discrepancy; mesh limits unresolved -> refuse. Continuous F-ball containment is NOT claimed for a discrete ball. Delta policy stays G3. Emit masses and a JSON evidence dict with all date-level mesh/refusal records for RunReport; forward forecast skips.

rho_calibration.notes: PROPOSED child audit adapter over shared generic bootstrap/grid owners; tier decision remains G3. Expected-loss candidate uses realized MINUS robust loss; upper mean bound <=0. Template evidence covers only that fixed population, not all MILP-selected trades. Match SP to F^-1(short_q) and SC to F^-1(1-short_q), each at the nearest same-type strike (distance tie lower), longs wing_strikes distinct same-type positions outward; require this node's explicit liquidity params, pinned equal to select base liquidity, standard contract and strict ordering, otherwise missing-template refusal. Payoff-only audit never uses completed-window pricing tiers. Calendar blocks: starts are observed dates; complete [start,start+B) date groups require start+B <= last_observed+1 day; uniform eligible-start sampling with replacement, concatenate until n dates and truncate; no calendar wrap. Before bounding, require every target date to have positive inclusion probability under this exact sampler and at least two distinct supported blocks; otherwise emit unsupported, never a passing bound. A passing bound also requires the full observed-date residual mean <=0. Refuse insufficient min_dates/no complete blocks/degenerate support, retain inclusion counts and full mean. This is an approximate block stress diagnostic, not a finite-sample confidence guarantee. Primary selection only; longer sensitivity reported. Legacy observed-count behavior stays unchanged. Owner approved expected-loss criterion and the finite-grid/smallest-passing procedure; phase choice, Delta and weights remain G3. No passing grid value means unsupported, without automatic expansion. Compute fixed-template/radius loss values once per exact forecast/checkpoint/input/grid/payoff/band/numerical identity; rho0 may use nominal expected loss directly. Bootstrap reuses cached residuals, never repeats LP solves. This adapter is still proposed; these keys do not make it executable. Calibration-only history gives constant rho; entry outcomes are excluded unless owner admits them. Every used outcome is published strictly before monthly reference. Emit rho and JSON audit dict (bounds/residuals/blocks/counts/all refusals), consumed by diagnostics. No test-profit selection. Base-template liquidity is unchanged across all sensitivity arms; they reuse the same rho, never recalibrate.

select.notes: PROPOSED PyomoSolve child subclass with explicit non-capital role. One all-ordered-strike dual MILP per ticker-date per declared arm. Resolve only the named arm override from the existing sweep list; base settings otherwise. No product/automatic expansion. rho_base uses calibrated rho; nominal uses0 even if calibration unsupported, as a labeled research comparator; calibrated arms with null rho no-trade. Validate same frozen candidate/contract policy and G1 action basis; known holding-window split/recap/nonstandard/irregular deliverables refuse, unknown action history stays an assumption. Per-contract prices separate puts/calls, haircut as configured and fee once per leg. Negative/missing/nonfinite premium or negative sell proceeds refuse that contract. Tiers estimated from completed calibration-window median trade_count are frozen for ENTRY pricing only. Primary maximize then second solve minimize z within certified dollar tolerance; report bounds/gaps and skip uncertified solves. Band support deferred; validate nonempty nominal-containing set if admitted. Emit decisions/selections/solves/skips with arm_id, unique decision_id and actual contracts, plus JSON evidence including per-ticker/arm counts and refusals.

settle.notes: PROPOSED child adapter reuses public dskit.production.accounting.WindowBook as sole accounting fold. Preserve raw entry and opposite-side synthetic expiry orders/fills for EACH leg, including zero intrinsic and zero expiry fee; these are evidence records, NOT dskit-eval-v1 events. Fold share-equivalent quantity=contracts*multiplier, USD/share prices and total USD fee (entry fee once per contract, zero expiry fee); never multiply fee again. Instrument is decision-scoped position_id encoding arm/decision/actual contract; retain actual contract and one-lot mapping. Both fills carry fill_label, expiry also labels.exercise. Reuse shared bounded settlement-close rule; later confirming bar itself pre2026. Assert per-position signed quantities end zero and WindowBook.realised equals independent closed-form multiplier*(credit-intrinsic)-entry fees. Do not use leg closes as trade counts. One condor outcome per decision. Evidence retains all raw records, mappings, reconciliation, arm/ticker outcomes/skips; no portfolio return or generic leg-statistic claims.

params.title: Robust condor calibration and single-trade evidence

diagnostics.notes: EXISTS RunReport with stages enabled. Stage labels identify mesh, calibration, selection and settlement. Exhaustive JSON preserves every raw decision/order/fill/solver/outcome/refusal record, diagnostic and reconciliation; Markdown renders stage summaries with its documented row cap and full-JSON pointer. Existing node-scoped artifact writer isolates arms. Condor outcomes are the statistical unit, not leg trips; no portfolio return. Shared base calibration is unchanged across comparison arms.

foreach.notes: Eight explicit one-factor arms, base settings except declared index override. No Cartesian product, ticker fan-out or fits. Existing foreach expands refs/$each and RunReport artifacts are node-scoped per arm. No RowsToEvents/EvaluationReport route.
